name: cellular-interface-spatial
description: The spatial translation of the cellular-interface study. The UNCHANGED CellularInterfaceHandler (local:CellularInterfaceHandler, the abstract fig03b cellular interface) is composed with a real 2D chemical field: a spatio-flux DiffusionAdvection process diffuses a left-low-to-right-high concentration gradient on a 40x40 grid, and a small field-point adapter (local:FieldPointCoupling) sits behind the handler's chemical port. Each tick the adapter samples the field's mean over the cell's footprint and feeds it to the handler as chemical_ext; the handler returns its net uptake flux (-uptake_rate*chemical_ext); the adapter deposits that uptake back into the footprint as a field delta, depleting the field where the cell feeds (niche construction), which diffusion then partially resupplies from the higher-concentration side. Same interface contract as the lumped fig04 composites, byte-identical ports -- only the process composed behind the chemical port has changed, now spatial. Only the chemical modality is spatialized here; mechanical, electrical and thermal remain lumped.
